target.title: [AI-assisted] fix(android): polish home overview layout
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves The Android Home overview looked slightly uneven because its primary overview boxes, Talk entry, and recent-session rows did not reserve consistent vertical space. On device, that made the first screen feel a little cramped and less deliberate, even though the content and behavior were correct. ## Why This Change Was Made This is a focused visual polish pass in ShellScreen.kt, following maintainer direction for quick wins around visual box sizing and cleanup. It is not a redesign and does not change navigation, gateway, chat, settings, or runtime behavior. Review focus: compare the before/after Home overview spacing, overview metric box heights, Talk panel height and padding, and recent-session row tap targets. The intended change is visual steadiness only. The change: - gives the overview metric tiles a consistent minimum height - gives the Talk panel a steadier minimum height and padding rhythm - gives recent-session rows a clearer minimum tap target - normalizes local spacing, padding, and corner-radius values around the Home overview components ## User Impact Android users get a calmer and more consistent Home overview layout. The difference is intentionally subtle: content, colors, navigation, gateway behavior, chat behavior, and settings behavior stay the same, while the Home overview boxes and rows hold steadier dimensions. ## Evidence Validation: - git diff --check: PASS. - ./gradlew :app:assemblePlayDebug --no-daemon: PASS. - pnpm native:i18n:check: PASS. Real visual proof on an Android API 36 emulator: before/after Home overview screenshots and videos are attached. Before the patch, the Home overview cards and recent-session rows reserved less consistent vertical space; after the patch, the overview metric tiles, Talk panel, and recent-session rows hold steadier dimensions.
